name: agent-dispatcher
description: Always propose a multi-agent plan with a solo option, then coordinate the chosen workflow.

interface.longDescription: Present a concrete multi-agent plan for every new task, including small tasks, with an explicit solo option. Wait for the user's choice, respect host capacity, and verify the chosen workflow's results.
defaultPrompt: Propose a concrete multi-agent plan for my task and offer a solo alternative. Wait for my choice before executing it.
